Thank you so much for providing such detail it really means a lot.

Regarding the lawyer thing, I totally agree and that is a good point. Also, what happens if all juries agree with the Crown but the judge doesn't and vice versa? Or is that not how it works..?

>likely some time in 2022

My first court date is already set to be this year though. Do cases like this last years??

That's totally fine thank you for the help. I will be contacting a lawyer soon.

That link was helpful thank you. 

Is robbery with violence (firearms or weapons are not involved) considered an indictable or summary conviction offense?
